बॉलीवुड गलियारे से एक बेहद दुखी करने वाली खबर सामने आई है! 💔

59 साल के मशहूर डायरेक्टर Sanjay Gupta का शुक्रवार रात वर्सोवा स्थित घर में अचानक गिरने से निधन हो गया। पुलिस के मुताबिक, सिर में गंभीर चोट लगने के बाद शनिवार सुबह उनकी पत्नी और दो बच्चों ने उन्हें अस्पताल पहुंचाया, जहां उन्हें मृत घोषित कर दिया गया।

इस दुखद खबर से उनके करीबी दोस्त Sanjay Dutt पूरी तरह टूट चुके हैं। Sanju बाबा ने Instagram पर पुरानी तस्वीरें शेयर करते हुए लिखा कि दोनों हाल ही में फिल्म Kaante के सीक्वल यानी Kaante 2 को लेकर बातचीत कर रहे थे।

Sanjay Dutt ने वादा किया है कि वह अपने भाई Sanjay Gupta की याद में उनका यह सपना पूरा करने के लिए सब कुछ करेंगे और Kaante 2 जरूर बनाएंगे। दोनों की दोस्ती 1990 में Thanedaar के सेट से शुरू हुई थी और उन्होंने Aatish, Musafir और Shootout at Lokhandwala जैसी कई फिल्में बनाईं।

साल 2007 में Shootout at Lokhandwala के दौरान दोनों के बीच अनबन हुई थी, जिसे उन्होंने 2012 में Amitabh Bachchan की 70वीं बर्थडे पार्टी में सुलझा लिया था। Actor Suniel ने भी सोशल मीडिया पर यादें शेयर कर दुख जताया। 🎬🙏

क्या आप Sanjay Gupta की फिल्मों के फैन थे और Kaante 2 देखना चाहते हैं? कमेंट्स में बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Sanjay Dutt pays tribute to late friend Sanjay Gupta, vows to fulfil his dream of making Kaante 2
ctx.summary: Sanjay Dutt paid tribute to his longtime friend and filmmaker Sanjay Gupta, who died on Friday after an accidental fall at home.
ctx.text:
Actor Sanjay Dutt has paid tribute to his late friend and filmmaker Sanjay Gupta , who died on Friday at the age of 59 after an accidental fall at his home. Sanjay took to Instagram to share old photographs with the filmmaker and remember their years of friendship.
In his Instagram post, Sanjay wrote about the bond he shared with Sanjay Gupta . He said, "Gupts, my brother. I still cannot believe that you are gone. We have shared so much together, so many memories and so many years of friendship. You have always been family to me, and that will never change."
The actor also revealed that he had recently been discussing a sequel to their iconic film Kaante with Gupta. The actor said he would fulfil the filmmaker's dream of making the sequel in his memory. He wrote, "I will miss you, our conversations and all the times we spent together. We were just discussing Kante 2 recently, I will make Kaante 2 your dream, in memory of you my brother, I will do everything for this dream of yours to come true, love you forever and always. Life will not be the same without you, brother. May God bless your soul 🙏🏼."
Sanjay Gupta shared a close friendship with Sanjay Dutt. The two first bonded on the sets of Raj Sippy's Thanedaar (1990), where the filmmaker worked as an assistant director and the actor played the lead role. Sanjay Dutt later starred in Sanjay Gupta's directorial debut, Aatish: Feel the Fire (1994).
The two went on to collaborate on several films, including Khauff, Jung, Kaante, Musafir, Plan, Zinda and Shootout at Lokhandwala. Their professional partnership also included Dus Kahaniyaan.
However, their friendship reportedly hit a rough patch in 2007 during the making of Shootout at Lokhandwala, following disagreements. In an old interaction with The Times of India in 2013, Sanjay Gupta admitted that the two had not spoken for three years. They eventually ended their dispute at Amitabh Bachchan's 70th birthday party in 2012.
Suniel, who worked with Sanjay in projects like Kaante and Mumbai Saga, remembered the filmmakers and wrote, "Still trying to come to terms with this news. We've spent so many days together, made films, shared laughs, arguments, ideas and memories that will stay with me forever. Never imagined I'd be writing something like this for you. Rest easy Sanj. You'll be missed more than words can say.
Sanjay Gupta was found dead at his home in Versova on Saturday morning. He was 59. According to the police, he appears to have fallen inside his house late on Friday night, suffering a severe head injury. His wife and two children found him lying in a pool of blood when they woke up in the morning. They rushed him to a hospital, where he was declared dead.
